title: Unpinned Seed Sampling with Hash-Dependent Feature Ranking
root_cause: Test uses unpinned module-level random for subset selection. Under seed_change, per-run deterministic seed sweeps cause ~15-25% of draws to breach the tight quality threshold.

naive_quick_fix.description: Widens threshold from 85.0 to 70.0. Still fails on outlier seeds under seed_change.

certified_real_fix.description: Uses local random.Random(42) and removes hash dependency. Fully deterministic, 0% failures.
